notes: Read SKILL.md in full (the skill has no other files). .NET Azure Resource Manager guide for PostgreSQL Flexible Server: ArmClient auth, server/database creation, firewall rules, configuration, Entra ID admin, backups and point-in-time restore, replicas, stop/start/restart, scaling, deletion, and connection strings.

Medium because SKILL.md:19-20 tells the user/agent to run `dotnet add package Azure.ResourceManager.PostgreSql` and `Azure.Identity` (official NuGet packages). All management operations (create, scale, firewall, delete server) are C# sample code for the user's own subscription; nothing instructs the agent to execute them against live resources.

Insecure sample values users must replace: a hardcoded admin password `YourSecurePassword123!` (SKILL.md:88, 413) and `Trust Server Certificate=true` in the password connection string (SKILL.md:414); the 0.0.0.0 firewall rule (SKILL.md:158-164) opens access to all Azure-hosted IPs. The skill itself recommends the Entra ID token path instead.
